title: CCManager configuration
description: Shape of `.ccmanager.json` (per-project, at the git repository root) and of the global `~/.config/ccmanager/config.json`. Both files accept the same keys. Canonical source of truth: `ConfigurationData` / `ProjectConfigurationData` in src/types/index.ts of kbwo/ccmanager (written against v4.2.3).

$schema.description: Ignored by CCManager. Present only so editors can offer completion.

shortcuts.description: Key bindings for the session view. Only the `ctrl` modifier actually works; `alt` and `shift` are rejected at match time.

statusHooks.description: Shell commands run when a session changes state.

worktreeHooks.description: Shell commands run around worktree creation.

autoDirectory.description: Generate the worktree directory from the branch name instead of asking for it. Default false.

autoDirectoryPattern.description: Path template used when autoDirectory is true. Placeholders: {branch} and {project}. Default "../{branch}".

copySessionData.description: Default answer for "copy Claude Code session data into the new worktree?". Default true.

sortByLastSession.description: Sort the worktree list by most recently opened session. Default false.

autoUseDefaultBranch.description: Skip the base-branch prompt and always branch off the repository default branch. Default false.

includeRemoteBranches.description: Offer remote branches in the base-branch picker. Default false.

commandPresets.description: The commands CCManager can start a session with.

defaultPresetId.description: `id` of the preset used when no preset is chosen explicitly.

selectPresetOnStart.description: Show the preset picker before every new session. Default false.

mergeConfig.description: Extra arguments for the merge/rebase action in the worktree menu.

autoApproval.description: Experimental: let CCManager answer a waiting prompt for you by sending Enter.

customCommand.description: Shell command replacing the built-in `claude` check. Must print {"needsPermission": boolean, "reason"?: string} on stdout.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the verification command. Default 120.

key.description: A single character, or the literal "escape".

alt.description: Accepted by the schema but never matched at runtime; do not use.

shift.description: Accepted by the schema but never matched at runtime; do not use.

command.description: Runs through the shell, in the worktree directory for status and post_creation hooks, in the git root for pre_creation.

enabled.description: The hook is skipped entirely unless this is true.

name.description: Label shown in the preset picker.

args.description: One array element per argv entry, e.g. ["--model", "opus"].

fallbackArgs.description: Retried once if the session fails to start with `args`.

detectionStrategy.description: How CCManager reads idle/busy/waiting state out of the terminal. Defaults to "claude".
